meta.title: build: Add optional build tags to reduce binary size
meta.body_summary: Implement optional Go build tags (fuzzy, mounts) to exclude heavy dependencies, reducing binary size from 16.7 MiB to 7.4M (lite) and providing custom build configurations.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot's build tag optimization with benchmark table showed 55.7% size reduction; merged without objections after maintainer refinements.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 814 changed lines across 22 files, this is a medium-sized edit by absolute volume. It fits a planned performance PR with clear benchmark evidence, consistent with a successful merge.

review_details.concern_detail: No blocking review issues; community member expressed appreciation for the binary size reduction effort.
review_details.performance_claim: Binary size reduced by 44% (from 16.7 MiB to 7.4M) using optional build tags for fuzzy and mounts features.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Conditional compilation with Go build tags and feature gating is a build-level optimization; Copilot successfully delivered a working solution with measurable size reduction.

detection_detail.code_reading: Equationzhao made additional refactoring commits after the initial implementation, indicating manual code review and adjustments.
detection_detail.benchmark: PR body included a size comparison table showing reduction from 16.7 MiB to 7.4M.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Build commands are provided to reproduce the binary sizes; no automated CI size checking evident.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No performance regressions were reported or observed.

core_change_summary.description: Added //go:build directives and lite stub files to optionally exclude fuzzy search (goleveldb) and mount detection (gopsutil) features, reducing binary size from 16.7 MiB to 7.4M. Updated justfile with build targets for lite, full, and custom builds.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Maintainer added unrelated refactors (theme utilities, JaroWinkler, termlink) and documentation renames; these do not affect the core size reduction.
change_trajectory: Initial plan and analysis commits added g_test placeholder and go.sum adjustments.
Core commit added build tags, lite stubs, and updated justfile.
Documentation commit added size reduction summary.
Renamed docs and performed gofumpt formatting.
Maintainer added multiple refactors: moved ToReadable method, replaced smetrics with JaroWinkler, added termlink support, and cleaned up modules.
Final justfile update added build commands for all platforms.

review_signals.summary: Appreciated the effort on reducing executable file size.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with build tag implementation and benchmark evidence.
sergeevabc commented positively on the effort.

PR merged without formal review after maintainer's additional commits.
